mode: read-only exact Git object review; no build, native execution, performance or Host qualification
scope: CurrentAccounts fresh parsing projection, immediate graph bridge, cache lifetime, complete-root/error/cancellation boundaries and their regression source
findings: CurrentAccounts has private fields and retains an immutable borrow of the exact State plus the freshly parsed full account BTreeMap. State is BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value>; no interior-mutability escape is present in that type.

values_for uses pointer equality while the immutable State borrow remains live. An equal clone or changed independent State falls back to the original parser; no serialized digest or caller root alone grants projection reuse.

The projection is returned only after complete account parsing, complete state root, account root/count/balance, non-account partition/aggregate/conservation and non-account root calculation succeed in the same operation.

ArithmeticCache retains CompleteEntry context/serialized bytes/commitment only. A matching complete-cache entry returns None for projection, so it cannot retain account parsing across calls. A cold calculation returns the projection directly to its caller.

verify_state_with_readback obtains the projection only when no PostWriteReadback is supplied, verifies record.state against the complete commitment, and passes the same immutable State into verify_with_current_accounts. The existing readback capability branch remains separate.

verify_with_current_accounts shares the original verify_account_values implementation with the fallback. Each invocation constructs a new NodeReader, loads the current root and all reachable child rows, retains count/digest/depth/path/duplicate/aggregate/account-value checks and every real per-node progress callback. No graph success is added to the projection.

Regression source covers equal independent clones, nonce/zero-balance existence changes, invalid account fields, complete-root/late errors, cached-call projection absence, root/non-root SQL corruption/deletion, and cancellation at each observed graph checkpoint. Those source assertions were reviewed, not executed by this reviewer.
limitations: This is not a full audit of the independent PostWriteReadback, history arithmetic, decoding cache or complete native owner.
Existing cooperative callback timing remains cooperative and the projection does not add preemption or bound the complete SQL graph traversal.
No claim that the original service budget, fixed Host campaign, runtime matrix or any production activation is qualified.
